protocol.rule: kept: in the compact set, the smallest feature set on the greedy backward path (chosen on the training perturbations' out-of-fold scores) whose score is within max(one paired SE, 0.001) of the path's best; a feature kept in the selected model's or the pool's compact set is not boxed. required_input: a feature that a kept feature computes through ctx.feature, directly or transitively (recorded while the kept feature is computed), whatever its own scores; it is not boxed either, since a lab that banned it could no longer compute the kept feature. Otherwise, in this order: harmful: dropping it from the full model raises the visible score by more than max(paired SE, 0.001); redundant: one of its columns correlates |r| >= 0.9 with a column of a kept feature (partner named); substitutable: dropping it from the full model lowers the visible score by more than max(paired SE, 0.001), yet the compact set does without it (kept features substitute for it); no_gain: any other feature outside the compact set (drop-one effect within max(paired SE, 0.001)); unrecomputable: it raised while being computed, or its plugin failed to import. Scores: pearson_delta per visible perturbation; each subset's ridge penalty chosen on the training perturbations' out-of-fold scores under one fold partition and reported under another, so only the validation perturbations are independent of it. 0.001 is a margin of practical equivalence, not a noise estimate. Built-in features are never boxed.
protocol.composites: a feature that computes other registered features through ctx.feature (a composite) is audited as one feature with its own columns; every name it calls, directly or through the features it calls, is recorded on its fresh view and on every view derived from it, also a name outside the pool or one that is not registered (the per-run 'dependencies' map); a feature that a kept feature of either scope needs gets the verdict required_input in each scope where it is not kept and is never boxed; compact sets and full models are reported as listed and with their required inputs expanded (the features and columns their members' own calls computed, each distinct computation once; a name whose every call raised is listed apart as a failed input and counted nowhere)

target_readout_weighted_residual_e182.description: Softmax- and linear-weighted average of leave-pair-out residuals of training perturbations, weighted by how much each q down-regulates target(p).

geneset_name_token_knn_residual_e200.description: Softmax-weighted average of leave-pair-out residuals of training perturbations, weighted by TF-IDF cosine similarity of the token names of gene sets containing each target.

kernel_ridge_residual_e223.description: Kernel ridge regression of leave-one-out training residual profiles on a combined gene-set-Jaccard + PPI similarity kernel among perturbations.

factor_geneset_bridge_loo_e239.description: For (p,g): sum over K latent factors of score_hat[p,k] * loading[g,k]; factors from truncated SVD of leave-p-out training residual matrix, score_hat from IDF-weighted gene-set overlap between targets,

paralog_compensation_e250.description: Paralog compensation: name-stem match between gene g and the perturbation target, scaled by control mean expression. Second column is the raw score.

knockdown_weighted_neighbor_residual_e25.description: Jaccard-similarity times knockdown-efficiency weighted average of leave-pair-out training residuals.

coresponse_graph_smoothed_residual_e282.description: Average over the top-k co-responding genes h of g (by correlation of residuals across training perturbations excluding p) of the gene-set-Jaccard softmax kNN residual for (p,h), weighted by signed cor

target_coresponse_loo_e283.description: Two columns: (1) Pearson correlation across training perturbations q != p between delta[q,g] and delta[q,target_p], shrunk by n/(n+shrink); (2) that correlation times the expected knockdown delta of t

compositional_closure_shift_e315.description: control_mean[g] * c_hat[p] and control_mean[g]^2 * c_hat[p], where c_hat[p] is a similarity-weighted average of leave-one-out abundance-proportional shift coefficients.

coherence_weighted_set_neighbor_residual.description: Weighted mean of leave-one-out training residuals of perturbations q != p, weighted by coherence of gene sets shared between the targets of p and q.

geneset_knn_response_e9.description: Similarity-weighted average of training perturbation deltas, weighted by Jaccard similarity of gene-set membership of the perturbed targets.

ppi_knn_response_e10.description: PPI-proximity-weighted average of training deltas of gene g over other training perturbations.

knn_deviation_x_confidence_e54.description: Similarity-weighted kNN deviation of delta g from the leave-one-out mean response, gated by the maximum gene-set/PPI similarity between p's target and any training target.

knn_deviation_x_confidence_e55.description: Similarity-weighted kNN deviation of each gene's delta from the leave-one-out mean response, scaled by the maximum prior similarity between the perturbation target and any other training target.

geneset_idf_knn_response_e53.description: For (p,g): average of gene g's deltas over other training perturbations q, weighted by IDF-weighted cosine similarity between gene-set membership vectors of the targets of p and q.

symbol_family_knn_residual_e92.description: Family-stem similarity weighted average of leave-pair-out residuals.

isr_atf4_program_e184.description: isr_loading[g] * isr_score_hat[p]: loading is LOO regression slope of residual on ISR activity; score is similarity-weighted kNN average of neighbours' ISR scores.

idf_geneset_knn_response_e76.description: Leave-pair-out weighted average of training deltas using cosine similarity of IDF-weighted gene-set membership vectors, sharpened by a power.

geneset_ppi_consensus_residual_e91.description: Consensus of gene-set-Jaccard and PPI-proximity weighted kNN residuals: sign(a)*min(|a|,|b|) when signs agree, else 0.

lowrank_residual_transfer_e25.description: Predicted residual of gene g for perturbation p obtained by projecting neighbour-weighted training residuals onto the top-r singular vectors of the leave-p-out training residual matrix.

min_shared_set_residual_knn_e194.description: For (p,g): weighted average of leave-pair-out residual[q,g] over q != p with weight 1/log(1 + size of the smallest gene set containing both targets); weight 0 if no set is shared.

reciprocal_target_response_e320.description: Two columns: col0 z-scored effect of training perturbations q on p's target gene placed at q's target; col1 dense weighted average of leave-pair-out residuals weighted by those z-scores.

reciprocal_target_response_e321.description: Two columns: (0) z-scored delta of training perturbation q on p's target gene, placed at q's target gene; (1) residual-weighted average using those z-scores.

keyword_category_mean_residual_e89.description: For (p,g): cosine-weighted mean residual of gene g over other training perturbations sharing coarse keyword categories with p's target.

neighbour_agreement_shrunk_residual_e202.description: Weighted mean of neighbour residuals shrunk by a per-gene signal-to-noise factor m^2/(m^2 + s^2/n_eff); plus sign-agreement column.

kd_weighted_geneset_knn_e66.description: kNN transfer of training deltas where neighbours are weighted by target gene-set Jaccard similarity times knockdown efficiency.

rwr_from_target_e12.description: RWR stationary probability from target on union PPI+prior network.

response_cluster_soft_centroid_e539.description: Soft k-means centroid response: sum_c P(c|p) * centroid_c[g] minus the leave-one-out mean response.

weighted_median_knn_response_e337.description: For (p,g): weighted median of delta[q,g] over training q != p with weights from combined PPI + gene-set similarity; falls back to the LOO median when there are no neighbours.

shared_geneset_score_e15.description: Weighted gene-set co-membership between target(p) and gene g, times LOO mean response.

knn_response_ppi_diffusion_e248.description: Weighted mean of training deltas using RWR kernel on PPI between perturbation targets.

target_knockdown_magnitude_e44.description: Leave-one-out mean delta of the target gene across training perturbations.

target_essentiality_proxy_e83.description: For each perturbation target, a proxy of essentiality/expression breadth: the fraction of control cells expressing the target gene above a threshold.

target_gene_geneset_overlap_e42.description: Jaccard similarity between gene-set memberships of target(p) and gene g.

target_half_life_response_e661_e692.description: Inverse control mean expression of the perturbation target (a proxy for short mRNA half-life) multiplied by the leave-one-out mean response of gene g.

half_life_modulated_pathway_response_e92.description: Element-wise product of target_half_life_response_e661_e692 and pathway_downstream_response_e785.

splicing_complexity_response_e963.description: Product of a target-level splicing-factor indicator and a gene-level splicing-complexity proxy, with a small target-specific modulation so rows differ across perturbations.

target_chromatin_state_response_e1158.description: Target-level chromatin accessibility score multiplied by a gene-level indicator of being in the same TAD / within a fixed genomic distance.

target_pathway_comembership_response_e11.description: Pathway co-membership between perturbation target and gene g, weighted by LOO mean delta of g for training targets sharing pathways.

tf_motif_binding_response_e1303.description: For each perturbation p whose target is a transcription factor, score gene g by the summed motif-match strength of p's TF binding motifs in g's promoter/enhancer, scaled by the leave-one-out mean delt

metabolic_pathway_flux_response_e1362.description: For perturbations whose target is a metabolic enzyme, score each gene by inverse shortest-path distance to the target in a metabolic reaction network, times the LOO mean absolute delta of that gene.

shared_tfbs_score_e1616.description: Shared transcription-factor binding-site overlap between the promoter of the perturbation target and the promoter of each gene.

rna_processing_regulation_response_e1642.description: Overlap of RNA-binding proteins / splicing factors interacting with both the perturbation target and gene g, weighted by LOO mean delta.

drug_target_pathway_response_e2151.description: Score for (p,g) = 1 if gene g is a known drug target AND shares at least one pathway with target(p); weighted by number of shared pathways.

combined_network_rwr_response_e840.description: Random-walk-with-restart score from the perturbation target to each gene on a union network of PPI, prior network and gene-set co-membership edges.

coessentiality_response_e1647.description: Co-essentiality similarity between perturbation target and gene g, scaled by LOO mean delta of g.

random_projection_all_features_e2763.description: Random Gaussian projection of the concatenated existing feature vectors for each (perturbation, gene) row, yielding a low-dimensional embedding.

phylogenetic_profile_similarity_e3036.description: Jaccard similarity between the phylogenetic profiles (binary presence across species) of the perturbation target and each gene g.

target_expression_breadth_response_e3053.description: Number of tissues where the perturbation target is expressed, broadcast to all genes.

coexpression_module_response_e3109.description: Same co-expression module membership between perturbation target and gene g.

tf_motif_coexpression_response_e3118.description: Product of shared TFBS score (shared_tfbs_score_e1616) and the Pearson correlation between the perturbation target and gene g across control cells.

coessentiality_profile_similarity_e3171.description: Pearson correlation of gene essentiality (DepMap-style) profiles across cell lines between the perturbation target and each gene g.

target_rbp_binding_response_e3281.description: For each (p,g), score = binding indicator of gene g to the RBP targeted by p, scaled by the LOO mean delta of training perturbations.

target_grn_centrality_response_e3319.description: Broadcast the perturbation target's centrality in a GRN, weighted by target-gene edge weight.

kinase_substrate_response_e3348.description: For (p,g), 1 if target p is a kinase and gene g is a known substrate, optionally weighted by number of supporting references; scaled by LOO mean response.

target_breadth_x_gene_specificity_respon.description: Product of the perturbation target's expression breadth and the gene-specificity (1 - breadth) of gene g.

half_life_target_deg_interaction_e3489.description: Product of gene g's protein half-life (inverse) and a binary indicator of whether perturbation target p is a proteasome/ubiquitin pathway gene.

target_gene_domain_similarity_e3557.description: Jaccard similarity between Pfam domain sets of perturbation target and gene g.

enhancer_promoter_corr_response_e3599.description: For perturbation p and gene g, correlation between the perturbation target's enhancer activity and gene g's promoter activity across conditions.

ubiquitination_site_overlap_response_e36.description: Jaccard overlap between E3 ligase sets of the perturbation target and gene g, weighted by mean confidence.

subcellular_colocalization_score_e1608.description: Overlap coefficient between the subcellular localization compartment sets of the perturbation target and each gene, derived from prior gene-set annotations.

shared_complex_membership_e3853_e3884.description: Jaccard similarity of protein-complex membership sets between the perturbation target and gene g.

neighbor_geneset_enrichment_response_e39.description: For (p,g), overlap between target p's gene sets and the union of gene sets of PPI neighbors of gene g, normalized by expected overlap.

splicing_element_similarity_response_e39.description: Jaccard similarity between splicing regulatory motif sets of the perturbation target's pre-mRNA and each gene's pre-mRNA.

pathway_x_ppi_diffusion_interaction_e401.description: Element-wise product of target pathway co-membership response and PPI diffusion KNN response.

proximity_interaction_response_e4055.description: For (p,g), score indicating whether target p and gene g have a proximity interaction (BioID/APEX) in public datasets.

mirna_seed_overlap_response_e4105.description: Jaccard overlap of predicted miRNA regulators between perturbation target and gene.

shared_tf_downstream_response_e4174.description: Overlap of TFs downstream of target p's pathway with TFs regulating gene g, weighted by TF binding confidence.

target_tissue_specificity_response_e4231.description: Target-level tissue specificity (tau) of the perturbation target gene, broadcast to all genes g.

signaling_propagated_tf_motif_score_e133.description: For each (p,g), sum over TFs of prior-network edge weight p->TF (direct or via <=max_path_length propagation with decay) times the motif binding score of that TF to the promoter of g.

partial_correlation_response_e1353.description: Partial correlation between perturbation target and gene g across control cells, controlling for the top n_pcs principal components of expression.

mutual_information_coexpression_response.description: Mutual information between target gene and each gene across control cells.

chromatin_accessibility_correlation_resp.description: Pearson correlation between target and gene ATAC-seq signal across cell types, times LOO mean response.

shared_metabolite_connectivity_e1508.description: Weighted Jaccard overlap of metabolite sets associated with the perturbation target and each gene, using metabolic reaction gene-metabolite associations.

gnn_embedding_similarity_e1606.description: Cosine similarity between spectral graph embeddings of genes obtained from a combined PPI + pathway + coexpression graph, propagated by a lightweight GCN-style diffusion (no external DL deps).

drug_sensitivity_correlation_e1659.description: Correlation of drug-sensitivity profiles across cell lines between target p and gene g.

metabolic_neighbor_response_e1725.description: For (p,g): number of shared metabolites between the reactions catalyzed by the perturbation target p and gene g, normalized by sqrt(deg_p*deg_g).

tf_motif_disruption_x_expression_e1737_e.description: Per-perturbation TF motif disruption score (from prior TFBS knowledge) interacted with gene control expression.

target_motif_activity_response_e1774.description: Inferred activity of target p's motif across training perturbations, broadcast to all genes.

geneset_jaccard_similarity_e1827.description: Jaccard index between the gene-set membership sets of the perturbation target and each gene.

splicing_factor_x_intron_count_e1848.description: Gene-level intron-complexity proxy modulated by a target-level splicing-factor indicator, plus a gene-specific term so the feature is non-constant across perturbations.

chromatin_loop_promoter_connectivity_e18.description: Promoter-promoter chromatin loop / Hi-C contact strength between the perturbation target's promoter and each gene's promoter, aggregated over available prior-network / PPI / gene-set neighbourhoods wh

metabolic_flux_coupling_response_e1937.description: Metabolite-set overlap between the reaction(s) of the perturbation target enzyme and those of each gene, computed from prior knowledge gene->metabolite annotations, with a knowledge-free fallback.

metabolic_flux_position_response_e1969.description: For (p,g): if p and g co-occur in a REACTOME metabolic pathway, score = exp(-graph_distance(p,g)) * (1 + pathway_size_norm), where graph distance is the shortest path in the pathway co-membership grap

multi_ptm_overlap_response_e1997.description: Aggregated multi-PTM (phosphorylation/ubiquitination/acetylation/methylation) site overlap between perturbation target and gene, scaled by leave-one-out target knockdown magnitude.

shared_tf_chipseq_binding_score_e2167.description: Cosine similarity between target p and gene g vectors of TF binding intensities derived from TF-target prior knowledge (ChIP-seq style).

target_chromatin_accessibility_e2203.description: Mean chromatin accessibility (ATAC-seq signal) of the target gene promoter, broadcast to all genes.

integrated_network_rwr_e2265.description: Random-walk-with-restart score from perturbation target to each gene on a network integrating PPI, co-expression, and shared pathway edges.

target_metabolic_flux_x_pathway_e2407.description: Product of target metabolic flux score (metabolic_pathway_flux_response_e1362) and metabolic pathway comembership between target and gene (metabolic_flux_coupling_response_e1937).

random_projection_all_e98.description: Random projection of several base features into a low-dimensional space.

coessentiality_network_diffusion_e82.description: Random walk with restart on the PPI network seeded by the target's essentiality profile; returns the diffused score for gene g.

control_mean.description: Mean expression of gene g in control cells.

mean_response.description: Average delta of gene g across training perturbations, leaving p out.
